description: This file defines a PHP class 'LeaveModuleStatusChangeSubscriber' which acts as an event subscriber for module status change events, specifically handling changes related to the 'leave' module in an HRM system. It subscribes to module status change events and updates widget module permissions accordingly.

classes.name: LeaveModuleStatusChangeSubscriber
classes.description: A PHP class that subscribes to module status change events, particularly for the leave module, to update dashboard widget permissions when the module's status changes.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns an array mapping the module status change event to the handler method 'onStatusChangeEvent'.

methods.name: onStatusChangeEvent
methods.description: Handles the module status change event; if the previous module was 'leave', it updates the dashboard leave widget's permissions based on the current module's status.
